hook: Your robot does a backflip and lands on its feet.
title: A Humanoid Robot Backflips And Sticks It
description:
Boston Dynamics' Atlas is a humanoid robot, and it can do a backflip. In the video it jumps, flips in the air, and lands back on its feet. It is real robotics, not CGI.

#Shorts #BostonDynamics #Robots
